initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed difference is 28/40 minus 48/60 = -0.10. Numerical verification does not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R293-2 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The design record supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the causal effect. The observed risk difference, 28/40 − 48/60 = −0.10, is descriptive; it does not uniquely determine E[Y(1)] − E[Y(0)].
